prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Replace the raw pin-count cut with a fan-out-damped cut weight (1/log1p(k+1) normalised) so hub/clock nets stop dominating the cut gradient, letting the partition actually separate moderate-fanout signal nets — this should cut total nets-cut and reduce the many moderate violations that drive TNS, while the criticality-weighted star-expansion locality term (kept from the parent) preserves critical pairs.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.116 robust(mean-std)=-0.013 min_case=-0.017 seed_std=0.045 tns_mean=+0.037 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.107 dWNS=+12.5% dTNS=+10.3% per-seed=[+0.06 +0.07 +0.19]
  C2: score=+0.026 dWNS=+5.5% dTNS=+1.3% per-seed=[+0.09 +0.01 -0.02]
  C3: score=-0.017 dWNS=-5.5% dTNS=+0.5% per-seed=[-0.02 -0.06 +0.02]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->136, wcut 421->400, crit_cross 0.011->0.011, repair_flips 103->118, changed-vs-baseline 15.4%
  C2: cut 318->309, wcut 1007->974, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->229, changed-vs-baseline 5.4%
  C3: cut 582->580, wcut 1955->1942, crit_cross 0.069->0.062, repair_flips 353->351, changed-vs-baseline 3.2%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response:
(1) Partially. Cut/wcut fell on all circuits and TNS improved (+0.037), but the gain is concentrated in C1; C3 regressed (score −0.017, dWNS −5.5%) despite lower cut, so hub-damping didn't uniformly help.

(2) C1: cut 137→136, wcut 421→400, dTNS +10.3%, repair_flips up 103→118 (more local churn). C2: cut 318→309, wcut 1007→974, modest dTNS +1.3%. C3: cut 582→580, wcut 1955→1942, crit_cross 0.069→0.062, yet dWNS −5.5% — criticality term not fully protecting timing there.

(3) Seed spread borderline: seed_std 0.045, robust −0.013, min_case −0.017; C2/C3 per-seed straddle zero.

(4) Gate the damping by fanout threshold or add a WNS-aware tie-break to recover C3 before adopting.
